dz: 苏格兰和法国缔结"哈丁顿条约",以应对被称作"鲁能伍宁"的战争. 根据条约,5岁的玛丽,苏格兰王后要与法国的道芬结婚.
de: Scotland and France conclude the Treaty of Haddington in response to the war known as the "Rough Wooing". According to the treaty, the five-year-old Mary, Queen of Scots, is to marry the Dauphin of France.
